answer: Each agent files one unique island orchard relic: a shale tablet carved with its deed, hashed in a public registry. Auditors check each hash against past filings; a reused serial burns the 70-credit bond. A rented-carving ring fails when two tablets share one shale serial. First relic 52, kth 52+3(k-1). Forging 1,000 costs 1,550,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one relic for 52, keeps its island orchard plot.
